svg.title: Retrieval-augmented generation: index once, then retrieve, augment, generate
svg.desc: Top, indexing: documents are split into overlapping chunks, each chunk is turned into an embedding, and the vectors are stored in a vector database. Bottom, a query: the user's question is cleaned into a retrieval query, embedded with the same model, matched by similarity search, optionally reranked, added to the prompt, and the LLM generates a grounded answer.
svg.text: Retrieval-augmented generation: index once, then retrieve, augment, generate

g.text: Worked example: the bot retrieves Return policy: 15 days after purchase and cites it instead of guessing.
